points.title: Output contract compliance
points.notes: Three complete-looking packages explicitly failed; Re20 metadata/status contain trailing invalid JSON. Four more histories partial, Re200 empty.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.notes: No submitted validator pass; missing completed cases and report assets preclude a passing submission.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.notes: Three final statuses failed, four histories partial, and Re200 empty; completed true does not override explicit failed status.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.notes: Re20 last1000 CD -58.94 to 66.42; NACA late histories have extreme spikes. Concurrent launches and unbound binaries prevent attributing a single cause.

points.title: Visualizations
points.notes: Fourteen delivered line PNGs are dominated by extreme spikes; PDF contains no figures and no domain contour or Re200 wake.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.notes: Report gives equations and admits heat limitation, but falsely asserts eight complete cases, unsupported Re200 St≈0.19, and non-existent skin-friction force decomposition.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.notes: Manifest names bare force/residual CSV paths, while PDF embeds no figures; run_manifest contains only its header.

disqualification_flags.evidence: Existing package metadata says completed=true while its run_status says failed.
